---
title: "Races"
---

```{python}
import polars as pl
from great_tables import GT, md, html, loc, style
import polars.selectors as cs


def format_duration(column: str) -> pl.Expr:
    seconds = pl.col(column).round().cast(pl.Int64)

    return pl.concat_str(
        [
            (seconds // 3600).cast(pl.String),
            pl.lit(":"),
            ((seconds % 3600) // 60).cast(pl.String).str.zfill(2),
            pl.lit(":"),
            (seconds % 60).cast(pl.String).str.zfill(2),
        ]
    )


def format_pace(column: str) -> pl.Expr:
    seconds = pl.col(column).round().cast(pl.Int64)

    return pl.concat_str(
        [
            (seconds // 60).cast(pl.String),
            pl.lit(":"),
            (seconds % 60).cast(pl.String).str.zfill(2),
            pl.lit("/mi"),
        ]
    )


race_personal_records = pl.read_csv(
    "../data/derived/race_personal_records.csv"
).with_columns(
    pl.col("race_date").str.strptime(pl.Date, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    pl.col("race_date_over_40").str.strptime(pl.Date, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    format_duration("finish_duration_seconds").alias("finish_duration"),
    format_duration("finish_duration_seconds_over_40").alias("finish_duration_over_40"),
    format_pace("pace_seconds_per_mile").alias("pace_per_mile"),
    format_pace("pace_seconds_per_mile_over_40").alias("pace_per_mile_over_40"),
    format_duration("gap_seconds").alias("gap"),
)
```


```{python}
race_personal_records_table = race_personal_records.select(
    [
      "distance_category",
        "race_date",
        "race_name",
        "finish_duration",
        "pace_per_mile",
        "race_date_over_40",
        "race_name_over_40",
        "finish_duration_over_40",
        "pace_per_mile_over_40",
        "gap",
    ]
)

(
    GT(race_personal_records_table)
       .sub_missing(missing_text="")

    .cols_label(
      distance_category="Distance",
        race_date="Race Date",
        race_name="Race Name",
        finish_duration="Finish Duration",
        pace_per_mile="Pace",
        race_date_over_40="Race Date",
        race_name_over_40="Race Name",
        finish_duration_over_40="Finish Duration",
        pace_per_mile_over_40="Pace",
        gap="Gap",
    )
    .tab_spanner(
        label="All-Time PR",
        columns=[
            "race_date",
            "race_name",
            "finish_duration",
            "pace_per_mile",
        ],
    )
    .tab_spanner(
        label="Over-40 PR",
        columns=[
            "race_date_over_40",
            "race_name_over_40",
            "finish_duration_over_40",
            "pace_per_mile_over_40",
        ],
    )    .tab_style(
        style=style.fill(color="#f2f2f2"),
        locations=loc.body(
            columns=[
                "race_date_over_40",
                "race_name_over_40",
                "finish_duration_over_40",
                "pace_per_mile_over_40",
                "gap",
            ],
            rows=pl.col("race_date_over_40").is_null(),
        ),
    )
)
```
